Metadata.title: PeerSlot — Meetings that move without the mess
Metadata.description: A calmer way for students to reschedule meetings within teacher-controlled availability and fair, automatic boundaries.

hero.body: Give students one fair way to move a meeting—into a time you already approved, before the 24-hour window closes.

product.title: A humane way to say “yes, within the rules.”
product.body: PeerSlot turns your availability into a clear set of choices. Students get autonomy. Teachers stop negotiating the same calendar twice.

board.title: Office hours
board.moveHelp: Choose one of 3 open times before Tuesday at 10:00.

howItWorks.title: Rescheduling, minus the back-and-forth.
howItWorks.body: Everyone sees the same availability and the same boundaries, so moving a meeting takes one decision—not a conversation.

principles.title: Teacher opens the week
principles.body: Publish only the times that genuinely work. Every option students see is already safe to book.

principles.title: Student makes one move
principles.body: A student can choose a better open slot once—without sending a message or waiting for approval.

principles.title: PeerSlot holds the line
principles.body: The 24-hour cutoff and one-change rule are enforced automatically, clearly, and consistently.

guardrails.title: Good boundaries make flexibility possible.
guardrails.body: The awkward “can I move it again?” conversation becomes a rule the product explains for you.
guardrails.lockedBody: It starts in less than 24 hours.

items.title: One reschedule
items.body: Enough flexibility for a real conflict, without turning the calendar into a moving target.

items.title: 24-hour protection
items.body: Once a meeting is close, it stays put. Teachers and peers can plan around it with confidence.

items.title: Availability stays in charge
items.body: Students can only move into times the teacher has explicitly made available.

comparison.title: One choice beats nine messages.
comparison.confirmationHelp: Both calendars are up to date.

finalCta.title: Keep the meeting. Change the slot.
finalCta.body: A quieter calendar for teachers, and a fair second chance for students.

footer.tagline: Meetings that move without the mess.

ProviderAuth.title: One page for every meeting you offer.
ProviderAuth.body: Create your provider account, choose your scheduling defaults, and share a booking page that stays inside your boundaries.
ProviderAuth.securityNote: PeerSlot uses a short-lived JWT for provider APIs. Your browser session is used only to issue and refresh that access token.

flow.signInBody: Sign in to manage your booking page and availability.
flow.registerBody: Start with email, Google, or Microsoft. Setup takes about a minute.
flow.onboardingBody: These defaults shape the times students see. You can refine them later from your dashboard.
flow.restHelp: Ten minutes is selected by default so consecutive meetings never touch.

overview.intro: Keep your booking page current, protect your focus time, and see what is coming next.
overview.noAppointments: No upcoming appointments yet. Your next booking will appear here.
overview.openTimesDescription: Bookable times after notice rules and existing appointments.

availability.title: Make room for the right conversations.
availability.intro: Add a free-time window once and PeerSlot turns it into appointment times automatically.
availability.previewEmpty: Choose a window long enough for at least one appointment.
availability.noWindows: No availability windows yet. Add your first one to the left.
availability.invalidWindow: Choose a valid future window that fits at least one appointment.
availability.saveError: Availability could not be saved. Please try again.

appointments.title: Know who you are meeting next.
appointments.intro: Upcoming sessions and recent booking activity, shown in your booking-page time zone.
appointments.noUpcoming: No upcoming appointments. Open times will remain bookable until someone reserves one.

settings.title: Set the rhythm of your booking page.
settings.intro: Keep the public page, appointment length, notice period, and link security in one calm place.
settings.restHelp: Rest stays hidden from visitors. It only delays the next bookable start time.
settings.publishHelp: When unpublished, your link and availability are hidden from students.
settings.saveError: Settings could not be saved. Review the fields and try again.
settings.linkDescription: Generate a new eight-character link if the current one was shared somewhere it should not be.

BookingPage.availableTimesBody: All times are shown in the provider’s time zone and respect their minimum booking notice.
BookingPage.noTimes: No bookable times are available yet. Please check again later.
